content: {"reasoning":"The missing required authorization remains unresolved after a medical-necessity appeal, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Correcting the invalid diagnosis pairing would not cure the authorization denial, so resubmission would not properly progress the claim. CO-197 assigns contractual responsibility rather than patient liability; with no secondary payer or established collectible patient share, the remaining balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
